mainEntity.name: What information should my website include to improve my AEO for roofing services?

acceptedAnswer.text: To improve AEO for your roofing services, your website should include comprehensive and well-organized information. This means detailed service pages for different types of roofing (shingle, metal, flat), clear explanations of your repair and installation processes, transparent pricing guides or cost factors, and a robust FAQ section. Showcase your team's expertise, local licenses, insurance, and customer testimonials. Ensure all content directly answers potential customer questions, uses schema markup where appropriate, and is kept up-to-date to maintain authority and relevance.
acceptedAnswer.description: To boost AEO, your website needs detailed service explanations, process descriptions, pricing guides, and a comprehensive FAQ. Include team expertise, licenses, and testimonials, ensuring content answers customer questions directly.
